messages:
sophia.li: Heads-up — saw a latency regression on SM90 when serving causal streams for models with head_dim=30. FlashV3 selector keeps flipping to the fallback SDPA slow path after a few steps. Repro attached in comments.

nick.w: Ugh, that sounds like the headmod alignment case. Did it start after the kernel-picker heuristics tweak last week?

sophia.li: I rolled the serving binary back and perf returned to normal. The change to prefer flashv3 on sm90 seems fine for most head_dims, but head_dim % 8 != 0 triggers an early fallback during causal prefix extension.

raj.kapoor: Can you paste the minimal repro (cmd + profiler snippet)?

sophia.li: repro command: `./serve_perf_test --model=gpt-mini --heads=16 --head-dim=30 --seq=1024 --causal --batch=1`

perf-bot: regression alert: route=redwood-prod/us-west-2 model=gpt-mini kernel_switches=3 avg_latency_ms=182 (baseline 98ms)

kevin.h: profiler excerpt:
```
kernel_picker: initial pick flashv3_causal_kernel
runtime: on-step seq=64 -> flashv3 accepted
runtime: on-step seq=128 -> kernel_probe failed (unaligned head_stride)
kernel_picker: fallback to sdpa_generic_kernel (slowpath)
KV cache: remap performed (head_remap parity adjustment)
```

raj.kapoor: Interesting — KV remap occurs which invalidates prefix caching assumptions and forces a path flip. That explains the stepwise latency climb as cache warms/unwarms.

nick.w: So two related problems: (1) selector is too brittle for non-8-aligned head dims in causal mode, (2) KV remap currently forces full cache eviction.

sophia.li: Proposed mitigation: add a soft-hysteresis on kernel-picker for the first N tokens after a remap (N=32?), and keep a micro-warmup batching window that probes flashv3 with a tiny microbatch before committing to fallback.

kevin.h: I ran a quick patch locally: `kernel_picker.hysteresis_tokens = 32; probe_microbatch=2`. Latency dropped back to 104ms in my run (still slightly higher than baseline but acceptable).

raj.kapoor: I'll own a proper fix. Plan: (1) change picker to not immediately demote flashv3 on a single kernel_probe failure, instead record probe_fail_count and only flip after >2 consecutive failures OR after >32 tokens post-remap; (2) change KV remap to avoid full cache eviction when head_dim change is only a parity shift — implement partial reindex + alias table; (3) add unit/integration perf test covering head_dim in [28..36] causal and non-causal.

sophia.li: Sounds good. @raj.kapoor please add a small perf test harness so CI catches regressions. Also add a quick dashboard panel showing kernel_switches per route.

raj.kapoor: Will do. I'll open a PR with the picker hysteresis + probe microbatch first. Linking the perf traces and flamegraphs here: https://ci.redwood/infraprof/trace/2509876543 (will attach artifacts).

nick.w: Thanks. Quick note: let's not special-case head_dim=30, aim general parity/stride logic so it covers oddities like 18/22/30/58.

perf-bot: assignment created: ticket RI-4521 -> raj.kapoor (priority=P1)

sophia.li: Great. We'll gate the Dedicated rollout on this being fixed for causal workloads. :white_check_mark:

kevin.h: If anyone wants to reproduce I put a tiny repro container at `gcr.io/rw-infra/flash-probe:rev-33` with the test harness.

raj.kapoor: PR coming in ~2h. I'll add benchmarks and a note about potential microbatch tradeoffs for latency vs token cost.

sophia.li: Awesome — keep me posted.
